knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.rationale: Full memory read, including historical source-sensitive M/N outcomes, execution failures, negative branches and latest declared knowledge usage. Current files resolve prior context-specific source absence. No callable paired-seed interface is exposed now.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Freeze the no-row anchor and remove its unused loss observer work in one operational candidate; avoid another M/N diagnostic pair or architecture sweep.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Only implementation cost/removal bridge; no new gradient rule or independent-seed comparison.
assessments.falsifier: Changed source/forward/gradient rule or non-retained behavior invalidates the bridge; one run cannot validate robustness.

assessments.rationale: Full original record resolved and scoped interpretations/alternatives/falsifiers read. Local propagation positives coexist with nulls; whole-training numerical cause untested.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No optimizer shadows or active magnitude intervention in the candidate; preserve uncertainty and future assessment reserve.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Bypass unused derivative measurements without treating local numerical propagation as final-score causality.
assessments.falsifier: Any attribution of final-score improvement to aggregation repair is unsupported by this contrast.

assessments.rationale: Archived primary lines240-289 inspected and local baseline source read. DIN target-aware pooling inherited; its original unnormalized attention differs from local softmax.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Retain existing target-aware prediction and BCE implementation.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Aligned normalized/half-tangent products predate this operational removal study; no exact replication or priority claim.
assessments.falsifier: A claim of novel attention or exact original DIN replication would conflict with inspected sources.

assessments.rationale: Retrieved card has organizer-summary-only evidence; no detailed original implementation/ablation. No measured local tokenization or capacity-allocation bottleneck supports adoption.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Observer-removal cost bridge retains shallow model and token count; no joint projected tokens or gated decoding. External task/split and field semantics differ.
assessments.falsifier: Reconsider only after local token/field bottleneck diagnostics and an affordable capacity/cost-matched replacement study; the card alone is insufficient.

assessments.rationale: Retrieved external report concerns context-derived queries and field-sequence bridging on a different task/split. No local query-generation bottleneck or matched replacement evidence justifies a new architecture under current reserve. No external performance transfer assumed.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No added query probes, bridge views, capacity or auxiliary supervision; preserve the current forward exactly. Detailed source claims are not used to establish this removal hypothesis.
assessments.falsifier: Reconsider with a consequential local query bottleneck, inspected primary details and a fully funded matched-capacity/cost control.
